models.reason: M01 blocked: no official dated ward-level inundation records or audited negatives exist (S43, T085), so labels, features and flood probabilities cannot be built (T089).
M02 blocked: no verified daily reservoir level or storage history (S28 KWRIS, T008), so labels, features and forecasts cannot be built (T092).
M03 blocked: no verified daily reported reservoir inflow with units (S28 KWRIS, T008); inflow is never inferred from levels (T095).
M04 blocked: no daily gauge rainfall with coordinates (S27 blocked, T077; S29 annual totals only, D113), so no gauge-day can be withheld (T098).
Ridge beats persistence on the locked 2020 to 2024 test; hindcast.
M06 blocked: verified Karnataka price history, price units and publication timing are required before implementing labels, features or predictions (T035).

M07 blocked: a known vertical datum exists for 4 of the 8 dams the gate needs (D103, T129), S32 daily history is sampled dates only and S34 awaits the unapproved T118 bulk OCR, so labels, features and forecasts cannot be built (T130).
M08 blocked: S35 is blocked and S36 holds 2018 district labels only, with no audited pre-2018 positives or negatives, so a forecasting classifier cannot be trained (T133).

M09 blocked: S37 holds only state-level NRSC counts (no landslide point, date, positional error or survey footprint) and S42 imagery needs an unregistered account, so there is no label and no surveyed absence cell; the 200-landslide gate cannot pass (T136).

M10 blocked: S22 exposes no price row and S23 is a one-day snapshot (5 Nov 2026) with an unverified price unit, so there is no weekly market-commodity panel, no 30-market sample and no 50 heavy-rain events; no effect can be estimated (T139).

M11 blocked: it freezes the Karnataka flood model M01 and needs common Kerala flood labels, but M01 is blocked (S43 has no official dated ward-level inundation records, T085) and M08 is blocked (S35 is blocked and S36 holds 2018 district tables only), so there is no frozen Karnataka score, no common 2023-24 labels and no 30 Kerala flood events (T170).

M12 blocked: S38 is blocked on owner step H04 (D135), so no static GTFS, real-time sample or trip linkage was read and there are 0 vehicle positions and 0 service days; a scheduled-delay label cannot be built and no arrival or delay can be predicted (T153).

M13 blocked: S38 is blocked on owner step H04 (D135), so there are 0 completed trajectories, 0 service days and no verified scheduled headways; bunching cannot be labelled and no flag or persistence forecast can be made (T156).

M14 blocked: S24 CPCB station data is blocked (D133, D134): resource ID, licence, fields, units, averaging interval and history are unread and there are 0 station rows, so no PM2.5 label exists; S04 CAMS is a model estimate and baseline input, never a label (T159).

M15 blocked: no Delhi source is enabled, S01 keeps no issue-time forecast vintages (D07) so no forecast is matched to observed truth, S02 is ERA5 reanalysis, which supports trends and exposure only, and S18 impervious inputs are blocked by robots.txt; calibration skill cannot be claimed (T162).

M16 is research-only: the rule runs on the held S08 daily grids and flag counts are reported (reports/models/m16-flag-counts.json), but 0 of 100 flags are adjudicated (T212, T213 blocked, D159), so precision is not measured and no quality claim is made. S22 and S23 hold zero price rows and S32 has no 28-day window. No IsolationForest challenger was run.

M17 blocked: S42 Sentinel-1 imagery needs a Copernicus account (proposed owner step H15), so no scene was read, and no independent inundation masks exist (S35 is blocked, S36 holds 2018 district tables and S43 has no official impact labels), so there are not 5 distinct labelled events; training would also need a Kaggle or Colab GPU, not the 2 GB local card (T173).

M18 blocked: S41 is blocked (T125, no publisher permission to store or classify items), so there are 0 permitted articles; the twenty annotation batches T189 to T208 are recorded as blocked (D155) with 0 articles selected, 0 labelled and 0 owner-reviewed, and owner step H13 has not happened; the gate needs 1000 permitted annotated texts (T209).

M19 blocked: it must beat the M02 baseline on the same reservoir level target, and M02 is blocked because S28 KWRIS has no verified daily reservoir level history (T092), so there are no reservoirs with 5 years of daily data, no M02 baseline and no target; no free GPU session exists either, as the Kaggle owner step H10 is open (T167).

M20 blocked: it recomputes an already-approved flood score from the exact M01 or M08 input snapshot, and neither is approved: M01 is blocked (S43 has no labels, T085) and M08 is blocked (S35 is blocked and S36 holds 2018 district tables only). M05 is the only approved model and is a drought model, so it is not a base; the controls stay disabled (T176).

sources.name: OpenSky flight fallback
sources.retry: The owner reads https://opensky-network.org/about/terms-of-use in a browser and decides whether the project accepts the terms for a non-commercial fallback (citation of the OpenSky paper, the data licence model, any limit on public display), and records that decision; then re-run T061. If accepted, anonymous use stays within 400 credits a day; an account and API client (OAuth2) would be a further owner step.

sources.name: Geofabrik OSM extracts
sources.retry: Any one of: (1) the owner downloads southern-zone-latest.osm.pbf in a browser and saves it in data/raw/S18 (a manual download is not a robot), then T021 checks it and T022 parses the local file; (2) Geofabrik states that scripted downloads are allowed; (3) a separate source task verifies the OpenStreetMap Overpass API for the few Karnataka feature types the map needs.

sources.name: India Data Portal Agmarknet / existing price data
sources.retry: Re-run T023 with a working browser render of https://indiadataportal.com/p/agmarknet (or the owner opens it and notes the download button, file format and licence shown). If downloads need a sign-in, that is an owner step. Meanwhile T025 (data.gov.in mandi prices, free API key) is the other route to the same Agmarknet prices.

sources.name: data.gov.in mandi prices
sources.retry: Capture a publisher statement tied to resource 9ef84268-d588-465a-a308-a864a43d0070 establishing the denominator of min_price, max_price and modal_price (including commodity-specific exceptions if units vary). Then re-run T025 and validate the mapping before enabling S23 or implementing ingestion in T026. GODL is verified; no new API key or licence confirmation is needed.

sources.name: NASA FIRMS active fires
sources.retry: The owner gets a FIRMS MAP_KEY (H09) and stores it as NASA_FIRMS_MAP_KEY in .env, then T075 is re-run against the documented area API; or a key-free FIRMS download link is read from a rendered FIRMS page (browser) and recorded with its terms.

sources.name: KSNDMC gauges
sources.retry: KSNDMC serves its gauge data over HTTPS with a published station list, units and terms (on ksndmc.org or the Varunamitra portal), or publishes an equivalent open dataset; then re-run T077. Historical hobli rainfall is covered separately by S29 (T079).

sources.name: KWRIS reservoirs and rainfall
sources.retry: Re-run T008 when one of these holds: (1) the owner chooses to register a KWRIS account (a new human-only step: the form asks for personal details), and the Web API terms then allow research use and the API returns daily reservoir history with units; (2) ACIWRM answers a data request to the helpdesk address published on the site with daily history, units and a licence; or (3) the public site starts publishing a reservoir history or export.

sources.name: BMTC and Namma Metro static GTFS
Karnataka RERA projects
sources.retry: The owner asks K-RERA for permission to reproduce the project list (copyright policy, by email) and records the reply; then T081 is re-run. Promoter names stay excluded either way.

sources.name: Telegram Bot API
sources.retry: The owner creates the bot with BotFather and a public channel (H08), accepts Telegram's developer terms, and stores TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in .env; then T083 runs again.

sources.name: Ward / taluk polygons and crosswalks
sources.retry: Taluk polygons: run a separate discovery for an official Karnataka taluk boundary source before any taluk-level map; until then taluk outputs use district or H3 views. BBMP 2015/2022/2023 maps: re-check licence before any public use.

sources.name: Official shelters and flood impact labels
sources.retry: Re-run T085 when one of these holds: (1) GBA, BBMP, KSNDMC or KSDMA publish dated ward-level flood incident records, for example control-room logs released on OpenCity; (2) the BBMP and GBA websites pass TLS verification, so their releases can be checked; or (3) at T222 the owner decides to accept the I Change My City complaints as non-official, citizen-reported labels with a written coverage rule for negatives, recorded in the decisions log. Without one of these, the C2 fallback applies.

sources.name: aisstream ships
sources.retry: The owner signs in and creates an aisstream API key (H12), stores AISSTREAM_API_KEY in .env, and the terms shown at sign-in allow reuse of the AIS data; then T111 runs again.

sources.name: Kerala 2018 flood dataset
sources.retry: Run T121 (S36 KSDMA post-disaster assessment) next: the official memorandum is public (e06) and may give dated district-level flood labels for August 2018. M08 then uses district resolution only and, without labels before 2018, a descriptive 2018 replay with no predictive accuracy claim. Re-run T119 only if the owner signs in to Kaggle (H10) and "Kerala Floods 2018" turns out to have dated rows and a stated licence.

sources.name: Permitted news RSS sources
sources.retry: Retry T125 when the owner obtains written permission from one publisher (Mathrubhumi English, The Hindu, Onmanorama or Times Internet) that allows storing headline, link and timestamp metadata from its RSS feed for a non-commercial public map and for a classifier (M18), or when a publisher issues an open licence or a terms update that allows this. The owner records the permission text and the permitted feed URLs; then re-verify the item fields, a quota and history, and enable only the permitted feeds.

sources.name: Sentinel-1 / NDVI quantitative imagery
sources.retry: Retry T127 when the owner registers a free Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem account (no card; accepts the terms and verifies the e-mail; a new owner step, proposed H15) and puts the login in the ignored .env as CDSE_USERNAME and CDSE_PASSWORD (read only by variable name; the docs warn against hard-coding them). Then re-verify with a short-lived access token that one small Sentinel-2 L2A band (B04 or B08 of a selected scene) downloads, check the quota against the account, and enable T128 for selected scenes only. If imagery is needed sooner, the owner may approve a keyless open-data mirror in decisions.md, after its own discovery task.

sources.name: CPCB station pollution via data.gov.in
sources.retry: In a browser that can read page content (the Browser pane read tools or the owner's Chrome), open the data.gov.in resource page for "Real time Air Quality Index from various locations", read the resource ID from its API tab and the licence text from the page, then re-run T146 with that ID: record one keyed sample (Delhi stations), fields, units, the averaging interval, last_update semantics and any history. Enable S24 only if the licence is verified and the units and averaging interval are stated by the publisher. The key already exists; no new key is needed.

sources.name: Delhi Open Transit Data
sources.retry: The owner completes H04 in a browser: submits the real time key request and the static data forms at otd.delhi.gov.in with an honest purpose (non-commercial research), accepts the Terms, keeps the key in .env as OTD_API_KEY (variable name only in code), and downloads the static GTFS ZIP into data/raw/S38. Then T148 is re-run to record one VehiclePositions sample, its protobuf fields, units, timestamp meaning, trip and calendar match against the static files, the key quota and whether the Terms allow the project's use; the source is enabled only if the licence allows it and the field map is verified. Approval may take time (e08).
